problem_type: Archetype-declared reference slots silently fail to reach the vendor request body
symptom: Users attach a reference image, generation either refuses ("发不出：参考图") or succeeds while ignoring the reference; reported as "GPT Image 2 失败" and "Agnes 2.1 连了参考图没传入"
direct_cause: fal's gpt-image-2 edit body read {{request.params.image_urls}} while the archetype projects the contract key input_urls, so no reference reached the payload
class_root: The join between a vendor-neutral archetype slot key and each channel's own body field name had no build-time reconciliation; both sides are self-consistent and independently green, so a broken cable ships
affected_population: Every (vendor, model, mode) whose archetype declares a reference slot and whose mapping renders a template body
Self-built OpenAI-compatible relays whose models carry the real model name on modelAlias
Canvas nodes persisted with a legacy shared archetype id after a profile split (Agnes Image 2.0/2.1)
invariants: Every reference slot whose modeSlotReach is not 'none' must have its value present in the rendered create body
Image-edit protocol selection sees both modelKey and modelAlias
archetypeForNode resolves the same archetype as the send path for the same node
generality_proof: The gate derives everything from production functions (buildArchetypeInputParams, taskTemplateParams, renderTemplateValue, modeSlotReach) over the seeded builtin catalog. It hardcodes no vendor, model or key name: it plants a synthetic URL into one slot at a time and asserts the rendered payload contains it. Slots the UI already narrows away (reach='none') are excluded, so genuine vendor capability limits (runway veo3.1 last frame, grok single image) are not false-flagged.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Reconcile archetype slot keys against every channel's rendered body at build time
Single archetype resolver shared with the send path, including legacyIds migration

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Probe over 45 model×mode and 64 promised slots found exactly this one breach; body token changed to input_urls, gate now green
modelAlias threaded into newapiImageEditProfileForModel; mutation test confirms alias-only gpt-image-2 falls back to /v1/chat/completions without the fix
Probe showed archetypeForNode returning agnes-image while the send path returned agnes-image-2.1 for the same node; resolver collapsed onto resolveArchetypeForModel

Multipart ops carry no template body, so references travel via multipart.imageSource and this gate's judgment does not apply. Independently covered by multipartOperation.test.ts (FormData image[] parts) and relayConformance.integration.test.ts real-PNG-byte assertions; verified passing this session.

Custom calls dispatch an imperative script, not a template body, so the archetype-key-to-body-field join this gate reconciles does not exist on that path. Its own separate weakness (the reachability guard being skipped) is recorded in residual_risks rather than silently folded into this class.

recurrence.reason: Three independent instances of the same mechanism (one fact, two code paths, only one guarded) surfaced in a single investigation across archetype/body keys, model identity, and archetype resolution
same_class_scan: Per-slot outbound probe over the seeded builtin catalog: 45 model×mode, 64 promised slots, 1 breach before the fix, 0 after
archetypeForNode vs resolveArchetypeForModel differential on a legacy-id Agnes 2.1 node: divergent before, identical after

prevention.invariant: No reference slot the UI promises is missing from the rendered outbound body
prevention.failure_mode: check:reference-contract exits 1 naming vendor/model/mode/slot, the declared key, and the promised reach
prevention.strategy: Hard zero, no baseline file. New gate wired into gates:contracts next to check:orphan-cables, which covers whether a cable is selectable but not what the cable actually carries. A vendor that genuinely cannot carry a slot must stop declaring it, so modeSlotReach reports none and the UI narrows honestly instead of the gate growing an exception list.

legacy_paths.rationale: The duplicate archetype-resolution branch was deleted in the same commit; archetypeForNode now delegates wholly to resolveArchetypeForModel, so no parallel implementation remains (P1).

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency was added, upgraded or retained; all three fixes are in first-party code.

migration: Not required: the fixes change seeded body templates and resolution logic, not persisted user data. Existing canvas nodes self-heal on the next archetype resolve, and existing catalogs are re-seeded from the corrected builtin definitions.
residual_risks: Custom-call scripts bypass the reference reachability gate entirely (runtime.ts passes createBody undefined when a custom call script exists), so a script that ignores the injected references view still charges the user with no signal

The custom-call trial run sends cannedTestInput with no reference material, so an image-edit script can pass its trial without ever exercising its reference path (buildCustomCallTestFixture exists but no UI imports it)

There is still no positive, payload-derived receipt telling the user how many reference images this request actually carried; only negative signals exist. Deferred as a user-visible change requiring mockup approval.
internal_only_reason: This is an internal join reconciliation between two in-repo sources of truth — the vendor-neutral archetype slot key (src/config/modelArchetypes/gptImage2.ts) and each channel's own seeded body field name (electron/catalog/falOfficial.ts). No external vendor contract was changed or newly interpreted: fal's wire field name image_urls and KIE/APIMart's input_urls were both already encoded in the repo from their original doc-checked authoring; the defect was only that the fal body read a param key nothing populates.
